proposals.evidence: Platts distinguishes Arabic-origin badan body (p. 141) from the separate Sanskrit-origin badan face (p. 140). Pothwari badn is the syncope of this regional Hindustani body word. The existing Hindi/Urdu badan entry represents the likely contact donor provisionally; Punjabi mediation cannot be excluded, and no direct Arabic borrowing is asserted.
